annotations.title: Add, edit or clear notes on transactions

description: Write the note on a transaction — **a list in one call**. An empty `note` clears it. This is the row menu’s *Add a note*: a line about one charge that is worth remembering. **Dry-runs by default**; commit with `commit: true` after the user has seen the table. Ids come from `transactions`.

commit.description: Default false. False previews and writes nothing; true makes the change.

notes.description: One entry per transaction. Up to 2000 in a call.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

name: set_transaction_notes
